# upcloud_kubernetes_cluster_authentication (Resource)

This resource represents an OIDC authentication issuer configuration of a [Managed Kubernetes](https://upcloud.com/products/managed-kubernetes) cluster. The cluster API server accepts tokens from the configured issuers in addition to the default authentication methods.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a network and a router for the Kubernetes cluster
resource "upcloud_router" "example" {
  name = "example-router"
}

resource "upcloud_network" "example" {
  name   = "example-network"
  zone   = "de-fra1"
  router = upcloud_router.example.id

  ip_network {
    address = "172.16.1.0/24"
    dhcp    = true
    family  = "IPv4"
  }
}

# Create a Kubernetes cluster
resource "upcloud_kubernetes_cluster" "example" {
  # Allow access to the cluster control plane from any external source.
  control_plane_ip_filter = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  name                    = "exampleapp"
  network                 = upcloud_network.example.id
  zone                    = "de-fra1"
}

# Configure an OIDC issuer for the cluster
resource "upcloud_kubernetes_cluster_authentication" "example" {
  cluster    = upcloud_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
  name       = "example-issuer"
  issuer_url = "https://accounts.example.com"
  audiences  = ["example-client-id"]

  claim_mappings = {
    username = {
      claim  = "email"
      prefix = "oidc:"
    }
    groups = {
      claim  = "groups"
      prefix = "oidc:"
    }
  }

  claim_validation_rules = [
    {
      claim          = "hd"
      required_value = "example.com"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required Attributes

- `audiences` (List of String) Accepted audiences for tokens from this issuer. By default, the first audience is used as the OIDC client ID in the generated kubeconfigs.
- `claim_mappings` (Attributes) Rules for mapping token claims to Kubernetes user attributes. The API requires the `username` mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_mappings))
- `cluster` (String) UUID of the cluster.
- `issuer_url` (String) URL of the OIDC issuer, e.g. `https://accounts.myoidcprovider.com`.
- `name` (String) Name of the authentication issuer configuration. Needs to be unique within a cluster.

### Optional Attributes

- `audience_match_policy` (String) Audience match policy. Set to `MatchAny` to accept a token that has any of the configured `audiences`. Required if `audiences` contains multiple values. Leave out to use the default policy.
- `certificate_authority` (String) Base64-encoded PEM certificate authority bundle used to validate the TLS certificate of the issuer.
- `claim_validation_rules` (Attributes List) Rules that the token claims need to fulfill for the token to be accepted. Use either `claim` with `required_value` or `expression` with `message` in each rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_validation_rules))
- `discovery_url` (String) URL of the OIDC discovery document, e.g. `https://accounts.myoidcprovider.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`. Use only if the discovery document is not served from the default location under `issuer_url`.
- `user_validation_rules` (Attributes List) CEL rules that are applied to the final authenticated user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_validation_rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Computed ID of the authentication issuer configuration. This is a combination of the cluster UUID and the configuration name, separated with a `/`.

<a id="nestedatt--claim_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_mappings`

Required Attributes:

- `username` (Attributes) Mapping for the Kubernetes username. Use either `claim` with `prefix` or `expression`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_mappings--username))

Optional Attributes:

- `extra` (Attributes List) Mappings for extra user attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_mappings--extra))
- `groups` (Attributes) Mapping for the Kubernetes groups. Use either `claim` with `prefix` or `expression`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_mappings--groups))
- `uid` (Attributes) Mapping for the Kubernetes user UID. Use either `claim` or `expression`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_mappings--uid))

<a id="nestedatt--claim_mappings--username"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_mappings.username`

Optional Attributes:

- `claim` (String) JWT claim to use, e.g. `email`. Requires `prefix`. Mutually exclusive with `expression`.
- `expression` (String) CEL expression producing the attribute value, e.g. `claims.email`. Mutually exclusive with `claim` and `prefix`.
- `prefix` (String) Prefix prepended to the claim's value, e.g. `oidc:`. Set to an empty string to not use a prefix. Mutually exclusive with `expression`.


<a id="nestedatt--claim_mappings--extra"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_mappings.extra`

Required Attributes:

- `key` (String) Domain-prefixed, lowercase key for the extra attribute, e.g. `example.org/foo`.
- `value_expression` (String) CEL expression producing the extra attribute value (string or string array), e.g. `claims.some_claim`.


<a id="nestedatt--claim_mappings--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_mappings.groups`

Optional Attributes:

- `claim` (String) JWT claim to use, e.g. `email`. Requires `prefix`. Mutually exclusive with `expression`.
- `expression` (String) CEL expression producing the attribute value, e.g. `claims.email`. Mutually exclusive with `claim` and `prefix`.
- `prefix` (String) Prefix prepended to the claim's value, e.g. `oidc:`. Set to an empty string to not use a prefix. Mutually exclusive with `expression`.


<a id="nestedatt--claim_mappings--uid"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_mappings.uid`

Optional Attributes:

- `claim` (String) JWT claim to use. Mutually exclusive with `expression`.
- `expression` (String) CEL expression producing the attribute value, e.g. `claims.sub`. Mutually exclusive with `claim`.



<a id="nestedatt--claim_validation_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_validation_rules`

Optional Attributes:

- `claim` (String) Name of the claim to validate. Mutually exclusive with `expression`.
- `expression` (String) CEL expression that must evaluate to `true`, e.g. `claims.hd == 'upcloud.com'`. Mutually exclusive with `claim` and `required_value`.
- `message` (String) Message to show when the validation fails.
- `required_value` (String) Value that the claim must have, e.g. `upcloud.com`. Mutually exclusive with `expression`.


<a id="nestedatt--user_validation_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_validation_rules`

Required Attributes:

- `expression` (String) CEL expression that must evaluate to `true`, e.g. `!user.username.startsWith('system:')`.

Optional Attributes:

- `message` (String) Message to show when the validation fails.
